says: The astronomer, yes, with a hard hat she keeps from a former career in lighthouses. Tools are a spool of string, a hammer she has never needed, and a jar marked optimism that she shakes when morale sags. Your fern frond comparison is lovely, I have drawn a few. One frond and then you scan for the neighbors. Do the neighbors ever turn out to be different species?

ops.text: one frond... then look for the others
